description: A finite CNF \(\Gamma\) is satisfiable exactly when at least one of \(R_{p,1}(\Gamma)\) and \(R_{p,0}(\Gamma)\) is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.branching.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true Γ) ∨
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p false Γ)
